chromeos-ec: Pass touchpad FW at build time First, a board-specific package, pulled in as a dependency to virtual/chromeos-ec-touch-firmware, installs the touchpad firmware to /build/poppy/firmware/hammer/touchpad.bin. We want to make sure EC is only allowed to flash this firmware, so we pass that firmware as parameter to EC Makefile (TOUCHPAD_FW), so that it can generate the required hashes. In release branch, we will pick both hammer EC FW (signed) and touchpad.bin from /firmware/hammer/touchpad.bin, and include that in the rootfs, so that hammerd can update hammer EC FW and touchpad FW. power_utils: failsafe initialization of KbdBacklight We trust the return of 'check_powerd_config' in terms of the keyboard backlight support, while the real life might not easy like this, in terms of coral/reef family SKUs w/o a real keyboard backlight but there is powerd_perfs of has_keyboard_light, this makes the subsequent command of 'get_powerd_initial_backlight_level' crash because of the assertion of CHECK(...) fails (by non-existing sysfs of /sys/class/leds/*::kbd_backlight), which breaks the power_LoadTest execution. i.e. localhost ~ # get_powerd_initial_backlight_level --keyboard [0914/002432:ERROR:internal_backlight.cc(98)] Can't init backlight interface [0914/002432:FATAL:get_powerd_initial_backlight_level.cc(53)] Check failed: real_backlight.Init( base::FilePath(FLAGS_keyboard ? power_manager::kKeyboardBacklightPath : power_manager::kInternalBacklightPath), FLAGS_keyboard ? power_manager::kKeyboardBacklightPattern : power_manager::kInternalBacklightPattern). /usr/lib64/libbase-core-395517.so(base::debug::StackTrace::StackTrace()+0x13) [0x78ae89b39153] To tackle this, add exception handling, treat command execution failure as malfunction, leave debug footprint, yet keep power_LoadTest continuing. i.e. power_LoadTest log would be: 00:55:42 DEBUG| Running 'check_powerd_config --keyboard_backlight' 00:55:42 DEBUG| Running 'get_powerd_initial_backlight_level --keyboard 2>/dev/null' 00:55:42 INFO | Assuming no keyboard backlight due to :: Keyboard backlight is malfunctioning BUG=b:65431460 TEST=do 'test_that --autotest_dir ~/trunk/src/third_party/autotest/files/ ${DUT_IP} f:.*power_LoadTest/control.1hour' without breaking by the command crash of 'get_powerd_initial_backlight_level --keyboard' Change-Id: Iab24183a5e8e3561d2d97774d22d8fc44bc3eeb8 Signed-off-by: Harry Pan <harry.pan@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/665397 Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

config_utils: Remove the sepcial field "inherit" from resolved config. The field "inherit" on the top-level of the JSON config dictionary is reserved for listing dependent configs. This CL modifies `config_utils.LoadConfig` so that it removes this special field before doing the schema check. As the result, the json schema of the config no longer need to define the format of "inherit" field.
